tasks.short: Record and report track inspection and repair information

steps.what: Read actual inspection notes and completed repair work orders; verify and capture track limits, mileage, repairs and equipment requiring replacement
inputs: Actual field notes produced by the repairer during inspection
Completed repair work orders and asset records
outputs: Checked reporting inputs, units, exact asset identifiers and field mapping in the maintenance work-order system

steps.what: Transfer exact verified track, mileage, repair and asset fields from work orders into the inspection-and-repair report draft
inputs: Actual checked work-order fields and mapping from s1
outputs: Report draft with exact populated fields and missing values flagged

steps.what: Write and check the actual inspection and repair narrative and replacement-equipment findings, reusing exact verified asset references
inputs: Actual field notes and completed repair evidence
Populated report and verified asset references
outputs: Actual human-written report narrative and replacement findings

steps.what: Check the completed report against original field notes and work orders; resolve wrong track limits, units, repair status or replacement references
inputs: Original field notes and work orders

steps.what: Save the checked report in its existing internal document workspace
Actually report inspected track or mileage, completed repairs and equipment needing replacement to the maintenance controller in the normal spoken handoff
inputs: Actual checked report and original findings
outputs: Actual spoken maintenance report and clarification of unresolved findings

tasks.design: Use the maintenance work-order system, {OPS_SYSTEM}, to populate exact verified fields in a report in {DOCS}. The repairer writes actual findings, checks originals, saves the record and gives the real spoken report through {TELEPHONY}; no record or reporting handoff is folded into physical repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing work-order fields are recopied into reporting records while the repairer still has to explain actual findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order reporting and field mappings can assemble exact values without inventing inspection or repair outcomes.
tasks.still_hard: Track identity, actual completed work, unresolved defects and equipment replacement needs require accountable human verification.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what was actually inspected or repaired and what remains unresolved.

ambition.what: No additional repair capacity or equipment availability is assumed.

reach.task: Receive actual inspection and repair findings and arrange any subsequent work
reach.learn: What work is actually complete and what equipment needs attention

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual reporting and work-order access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native work-order report fields and exact reference reuse can reduce reporting duplication while repair findings and actual maintenance handoffs remain human.

assumptions: Representative record-and-spoken-report episode where work-order fields are actually copied into a reporting record. The repairer produces original field notes during actual inspection, and repair staff produce real work orders during actual work; those source tasks remain unchanged and must be counted once in a full workflow. Focal source verification, required input entry and mapping are counted fully in s1.

s1 produces every field, identifier, track limit, unit and mapping used by s2. Paper-only or missing information requires actual manual transcription or investigation in s1, not a free clean digital feed. Actual inspection and repair are never inferred from a scheduled work order.

Use the current work-order system's native report first. If it already assembles s2, there is no new gain for those fields. s3 reduces only exact reference copying; actual repair narrative, replacement findings and checking remain human. s4 is ordinary report checking, not self-approval.

This episode explicitly records the written report and separately gives the actual ordinary spoken handoff. No written send, status release, replacement order, work closure or instruction is hidden in either. If actual reporting requires electronic submission, add the completed final report, its real reporting authority and a distinct gated send rather than treating a save as submission.

The maintenance controller's actual receiving and clarification work remains unchanged and is not claimed as saving. Subsequent replacement planning, orders and physical work need actual separate steps if estimating that wider process. A report never authorises equipment return to service.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 25+20*0.10=27; new upkeep 3 leaves net 24. Retained s1,s3,s4,s6 labour totals 72 already counted. Ordinary same-system save is minimum integer share 1 for negligible active effort, fully retained and ungated, with no self-approval or saving.
unknowns: Actual written versus spoken reporting channels
Existing native work-order reporting and field duplication
research_questions: Trace one actual track inspection and repair report from original notes to its record and real handoff; measure actual duplicate entry.

already_counted.description: Source capture, actual narrative writing, complete report checking and real spoken reporting remain in s1,s3,s4,s6.

incremental.description: Maintain reporting field mappings and source-link checks beyond ordinary report checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs 25 points of actual manual field copying plus 2 reference-copying points. If native work-order reporting already handles 18 of those field-copying points, eligible gross is 7+2=9; 3 upkeep leaves 6. If all copying is already native, re-estimate below this range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Repair and inspection staff producing original evidence
skills_to_grow: Clear separation of completed work and unresolved defects
Accurate spoken reporting without implied service release
role.ambitious_version: A signal and track switch repairer whose actual inspection and repair findings reach maintenance staff with less duplicate entry and unchanged human accountability.
